title: Handler or Effect? Is the logic reactive?

slides.say: A chat room must stay connected, and must send a message on click. One is an Effect, one is a handler. Here is the precise reason.
Logic in event handlers is not reactive. Typing changes message, but that does not mean the user wants to send. It only runs on the click.
Logic in Effects is reactive. A new room id does mean the user wants a different room, so it should re-run.

slides.text: Should this re-run when the value changes? Effect. Only on an interaction? Handler.
slides.say: So ask: should this code keep up with a changing value? Effect. Should it run only on a specific interaction? Event handler.
